name: The Residences
tagline: Waterfront Town Center living with boat slips
summary: The Residences is a small community of 27 waterfront homes at 400 150th Avenue in Madeira Beach, completed, developer-owned and never occupied. Each three-bedroom, three-bath residence offers approximately 1,800 square feet with every bedroom en suite, and boat slips are available. It is part of the Madeira Beach Town Center master-planned community, walkable to the beach, shops, restaurants and The Beachmaker resort now under construction.

faqs.q: What is the minimum rental period at The Residences in Madeira Beach?
faqs.a: The minimum rental period is 30 days, with one rental per 30 days. Owners may self-manage; no management company is required.

faqs.q: Can I homestead a residence at The Residences?
faqs.a: Yes. Residences are primary residence and homestead eligible, subject to buyer qualification.

faqs.q: Are boat slips available at The Residences?
faqs.a: Yes. Boat slips are available at this waterfront community.

faqs.q: What does it take to buy at The Residences?
faqs.a: A $10,000 initial deposit and a 10% total down payment, with cash, conventional or DSCR financing subject to underwriting.
